Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379),
I hope this letter is a sufficient acknowledgement of the [£25](../others.html#160), as I have no receipt stamp at hand and this village does not provide such articles, and as they must not be bought of the unprivileged[^1] I cannot beg or borrow too often from our worthy [neighbours](../persons.html#360) at the shop

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Unprivileged: Those without a license to sell.
